page_title: VER 0-3 LAZ | Verona v Lazio 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and Ondrej Duda (Verona) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
88' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
87' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
84' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio) replaces Nicolo Rovella.
84' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:5.

81' Diego Coppola (Verona) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
81' Verona get a corner.
78' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
77' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

74' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
73' Substitution. Jackson Tchatchoua makes way for Davide Faraoni (Verona).
73' The referee signals a substitution. Reda Belahyane (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Amin Sarr.
73' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Nuno Tavares and he is replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
72' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
70' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:12.
66' The game has come to an end for Gustav Isaksen. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pedro (Lazio).
66' A substitution has been made. Samuel Gigot is replaced by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mattia Zaccagni departs the field of play to be replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
65' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Casper Tengstedt is replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
65' Here comes a substitution. Tomas Suslov is given a rest as he is replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).

64' Ambitious effort from Taty Castellanos (Lazio). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
61' The corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is cleared away by the defence.
58' 0 - 3 Goal! Boulaye Dia plays it to Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Lorenzo Montipo. 0:3.
57' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

52' A cross by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
49' The game has begun to heat up. Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Coppola (Verona) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Amin Sarr (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a half-time substitution. Dailon Rocha Livramento comes on in place of Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Michael Fabbri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
44' Ondrej Duda picks out Suat Serdar (Verona) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.

42' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Casper Tengstedt (Verona) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

40' What a chance that is! Ondrej Duda (Verona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
37' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

37' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the right side of the goal is far too weak and Lorenzo Montipo makes a simple save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
32' Verona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' The ball possession at the moment is 31:69.
26' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) for his blatant foul.
21' 0 - 2 Boulaye Dia (Lazio) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Lorenzo Montipo with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
19' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
17' Amin Sarr (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Samuel Gigot (Lazio) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

13' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Lorenzo Montipo. This effort really didn't trouble him.
9' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Taty Castellanos (Lazio), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
6' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
4' A pass into the box finds Casper Tengstedt (Verona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Ivan Provedel denies him.
2' 0 - 1 Mattia Zaccagni sends in a great cross from the corner, finding Samuel Gigot (Lazio) who outjumps the defence to finish into the top right corner with a header. The score is 0:1.
2' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

1' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Fabbri with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Fabbri.
